description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: divide_loop's tail strategy defaults to "guard" (docs/primitives/loop_ops.md signature and tail argument): the signature's default, and a call that omits tail prints exactly what the same call with tail="guard" prints (judged in the parent as an equal pair; the printed guard form itself is not pinned here).
cut_loop accepts any cut point with lo <= cut_point <= hi, including cut_point == hi (docs/primitives/loop_ops.md).
specialize with n conditions makes n+1 copies tested in order: if cond_0 / elif cond_1 / ... / else (docs/primitives/loop_ops.md).
rearrange_dim reorders the dimensions so that new dimension k is old dimension permute_vector[k] ([2,0,1]: x : T[N,M,K] -> x : T[K,N,M]) (docs/primitives/buffer_ops.md).
bind_expr allocates the new scalar buffer with the precision of the bound expression (docs/primitives/buffer_ops.md).
split_write turns `a = b + c` into `a = b; a += c` and `a += b + c` into `a += b; a += c` (docs/primitives/other_ops.md).
ui16 lowers to the C type uint16_t (docs/memories.md, docs/externs.md type mapping).
ExoType.is_indexable() is True for Index, Size, Int and Stride (docs/Cursors.md ExoType).
exocc names the generated .c and .h files after the source file unless --stem is given, also when -o selects the output directory (README.md "Compile Exo").
stdlib.inspection.get_parents yields the ancestors of stmt (exclusive) up to up_to (inclusive) (docstring).
StmtCursor.prev(dist) returns the statement dist-many before (InvalidCursor when there is none) (docstring).
divide_loop with explicit tail cut / cut_and_guard / guard and perfect=True (loop_ops.md).
divide_with_recompute, mult_loops and join_loops rewrites (loop_ops.md).
cut_loop inside the range and its lo <= cut_point bound, shift_loop and its 0 <= new_lo bound (loop_ops.md).
reorder_loops (cursor and 'outer inner' shorthand) and fission at a gap (loop_ops.md).
add_loop (with and without guard), remove_loop and unroll_loop (loop_ops.md).
lift_scope, fuse of loops and of ifs, and specialize with one condition (loop_ops.md).
bind_expr of a literal-scaled expression (the buffer_ops.md example, R precision) and of repeated expressions (common subexpressions bound together).
resize_dim (offset and fold) and expand_dim (buffer_ops.md).
rearrange_dim with a 2-D swap, divide_dim and mult_dim (the buffer_ops.md examples).
unroll_buffer, lift_alloc and sink_alloc (buffer_ops.md).
reuse_buffer, delete_buffer and inline_window (buffer_ops.md, other_ops.md).
stage_mem loading/storing a window and accum=True (buffer_ops.md).
rename, make_instr, insert_pass and delete_pass (other_ops.md).
simplify and eliminate_dead_code (other_ops.md).
reorder_stmts, commute_expr, left_reassociate_expr and rewrite_expr (other_ops.md).
merge_writes (all four assign/reduce cases), fold_into_reduce and inline_assign (other_ops.md).
lift_reduce_constant (other_ops.md).
set_precision, set_window, set_memory and parallelize_loop (backend_ops.md).
bind_config, write_config and delete_config (config_ops.md).
extract_subproc and inline (subproc_ops.md).
replace (unification) and call_eqv (subproc_ops.md).
Window arguments (the object_code.md foo/bar example: window structs in C), tensor arguments and the window-shape bounds check (object_code.md).

Aliasing arguments, passing a window to a non-window parameter, non-affine indexing and value-dependent control flow are rejected; quasi-affine division/modulo by constants is accepted (object_code.md).
Precision types, the DRAM default for allocations, seq(start, end) loops and if/else in generated C (object_code.md).
Procedure.name/is_instr/get_instr, c_code_str, compile_c, partial_eval, transpose, add_assertion and unsafe_assert_eq (Procedures.md).
compile_procs_to_strings / compile_procs on several procedures (API.py; Procedures.md compilation).
Procedure.args/body/find/find_loop/find_alloc_or_arg/find_all, the #n pattern selector and the no-match error (Cursors.md).
next/prev, before/after gaps, parent, as_block, expand, body/orelse, block indexing and slicing, GapCursor.anchor (Cursors.md, API_cursors docstrings).
The methods of ArgCursor, AssignCursor, ReduceCursor, ForCursor, IfCursor, AllocCursor, CallCursor and WindowStmtCursor (Cursors.md).
Explicit p.forward(c) and implicit forwarding of cursors passed to primitives (Cursors.md).
The inspection.md example functions (is_loop, get_top_level_stmt) and ExoType members (inspection.md).
The import paths listed in Imports.md resolve.
exo.stdlib.inspection helpers: get_lca, get_depth, match_parent, get_enclosing_loop(_by_name), get_children, lrn/nlr traversals (stdlib/inspection.py).
User-defined memories: alloc/free/window/global_ in generated C, can_read=False rejects direct access, set_memory, and the library AVX2/DRAM_STATIC memories (memories.md, libs/memories.py).
User-defined externs (typecheck, compile, globl; the externs.md _Sin example) and the library externs; externs may take the same buffer several times (externs.md, libs/externs.py).
@instr procedures: the {name_data} placeholders in the emitted C, replace with an instruction, and the instruction body as its semantics (instructions.md).
with python / with exo quoting and unquoting of statements, expressions, numbers, types, indices and memories (Metaprogramming.md).

Back-end checks at code generation: memory consistency between caller and callee (mem_analysis), window annotation consistency (win_analysis) and precision coercion (prec_analysis) (System.md, backend_ops.md).
Frontend type checking and bounds/assertion checking reject ill-typed, out-of-bounds and unsatisfiable procedures (System.md).

Rewrite-based scheduling keeps the input procedure unchanged and returns a new procedure whose state can be printed at any point; scheduling errors are SchedulingError (Design.md, System.md, docs/README.md).
exocc writes NAME.c and NAME.h into a directory named after the source file by default, -o picks the directory and --stem the file names (README.md).
exo.stdlib.scheduling: repeat, replace_all, lift_if (stdlib/scheduling.py).
exo.stdlib.stdlib tile_loops and the halide-style tile (stdlib/stdlib.py, stdlib/halide_scheduling_ops.py).
